Claim 1 (Currently amended): A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers and has a thickness of about 3.5 mm.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of about 2.5 mm.
